variables.name: discloser_name
variables.description: Full legal name of the disclosing party

variables.name: discloser_form
variables.description: Optional legal form and any identifiers applicable to this party, verified from its records; do not presume RC, ICE, or IF applies.

variables.name: discloser_address
variables.description: Address for notices to the disclosing party

variables.name: discloser_signatory
variables.description: Name and stated capacity of the discloser signatory; verify actual authority separately.

variables.name: recipient_name
variables.description: Full legal name of the receiving party

variables.name: recipient_form
variables.description: Optional legal form and any identifiers applicable to this party, verified from its records; do not presume RC, ICE, or IF applies.

variables.name: recipient_address
variables.description: Address for notices to the receiving party

variables.name: recipient_signatory
variables.description: Name and stated capacity of the recipient signatory; verify actual authority separately.

variables.name: effective_date
variables.description: Date the parties intend this agreement to take effect

variables.name: purpose
variables.description: Specific permitted evaluation or collaboration purpose

variables.name: agreement_term
variables.description: Chosen period during which disclosures may be made

variables.name: confidentiality_period
variables.description: Chosen duration of confidentiality obligations after the agreement ends

variables.name: governing_law
variables.description: Law selected by the parties after advice on validity and conflicts

variables.name: dispute_forum
variables.description: Chosen dispute forum or process after advice on validity and suitability

variables.name: notice_email_discloser
variables.description: Optional notice email for the disclosing party

variables.name: notice_email_recipient
variables.description: Optional notice email for the receiving party
